title: What Is Kept for Optional Items Paid for in Advance on Car Hire
content:
Two things decide what is kept for the optional items a renter paid for in advance when money is returned
on a hire booked under the Car Rental Rate Classes: when those items were sold, and whether the vehicle was
ever collected.

1. Where the optional items were sold on the day the rental was booked and the vehicle was never collected,
   nothing is kept for them.
2. Where the optional items were sold after the day the rental was booked and the vehicle was never
   collected, 20 per cent of what was taken for them is kept.
3. Where neither of those holds of a rental, no reduction under this head is made to what is kept for those
   items.

| When the optional items were sold | Vehicle collected | Kept |
| --- | --- | --- |
| on the day the rental was booked | never collected | nothing |
| after the day the rental was booked | never collected | 20 per cent of what was taken for them |

## How the two rows divide

Both rows require that the vehicle was never collected. On a rental whose records show the vehicle was
collected, neither row is reached, whenever the items were sold.

The two rows divide on the day of sale against the day of booking. Items sold on the booking day itself fall
in the first row; items sold on any later day fall in the second.

## A worked example on hypothetical dates

A rental booked on a Monday, on which optional items of 80 USD were sold the following Thursday, and whose
vehicle was never collected: 20 per cent of 80 USD, which is 16 USD, is kept. Had the same items been sold
on the Monday the rental was booked, nothing would be kept for them.
